_comment: Default Tavily research budgets for Opportunity Radar. Override per run with `research_ledger.py init <run> --profile quick|deep --budget N`. Credit rates below come from the installed tavily-best-practices docs (read 2026-10-22); rows marked estimated are NOT documented there and must be reported as estimates.

quick.purpose: Discover promising signals, research a small set of candidates, reject weak ones early, minimise credits.

deep.purpose: Investigate the strongest candidates: competitors, customer problems, pricing, economics, contradicting evidence; complete dossiers and validation plans.

basic.basis: estimated (same rate as crawl extract_depth, which is documented)

advanced.basis: estimated (same rate as crawl extract_depth, which is documented)

mini.basis: unknown - reservation only, not a price; calibrate from your Tavily dashboard

pro.basis: unknown - reservation only, not a price; calibrate from your Tavily dashboard

auto.basis: unknown - reservation only, not a price; calibrate from your Tavily dashboard
